test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution.’**

They **__is going__** to Delhi with their friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **"are going."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Subject-Verb agreement, a singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
• The subject **"they"** is a plural pronoun and it requires a plural verb.
 
 
• **Example**: ***They are**__ leaving the house.*
 
 
 
• **"Are going"** is a plural verb.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Correct sentence**: *They __**are going**__ to Delhi with their friends.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Was going" is incorrect because it uses a singular verb for a plural subject.
 
• "Will going" is incorrect because it uses "will" and "going" together, which is redundant.
